title: Non-intrusive torque measurement for rotating shafts using optical sensing of zebra-tapes
authors: D Zappalá | M Bezziccheri | C J Crabtree | N Paone
locator: Physical rig, optical calibration and static/dynamic tests; Figs. 13–21. Full article in the SUPERGEN Durham report.
finding: Magtrol in-line reference and two optical tape algorithms compared under steady and variable loading. The deposited timing columns differ in sample support. Recomputed fixed-grid contrasts are in optical-clock-matched.csv.
rights: CC BY as printed by IOP. Original annotation only.

title: Investigating wind turbine dynamic transient loads using contactless shaft torque measurements
authors: Donatella Zappalá | Christopher J. Crabtree | Simon Hogg
locator: Sections 2–4, transient-load test rig, ref. 14; full journal article in the SUPERGEN report.
finding: A separate publication in the same Durham measurement family uses two optical sensors and in-line torque comparisons under transient loads. Study-family overlap precludes counting its figures as an independent dataset.
rights: CC BY 3.0 as printed in journal PDF; original annotation only.

title: Calibration of torque measurement under constant rotation in a wind turbine test bench
authors: Paula Weidinger | Gisa Foyer | Stefan Kock | Jonas Gnauert | Rolf Kumme
finding: Existing work revisited with newly ingested physical files. The external DAQ and the bench use a common sync waveform. Zero reference is determined under rotation and subtracted in post-processing.

title: Traceable Torque Measurement under Rotation in Nacelle Test Benches : A Good Practice Guide
finding: Gives practical guidance on independent DAQ synchronization, rotation and zero signals for torque calibration, relevant to choosing how to tare the public bench traces.
rights: Publicly accessible report; see PTB deposit. Bibliography and original notes.

title: D6.2 - Characterisation of a 5 MN·m Torque Transducer by Combining Traditional Calibration and Finite Element Method Simulations
authors: P. Weidinger | C. Schlegel | G. Foyer | R. Kumme
locator: Experimental and finite element calibration, conclusion.
finding: Physical calibration and finite element estimates are separately identified. Extrapolated high-load results are not additional direct reference measurements.
rights: Public proceedings PDF. Original citation and notes only.

title: Development of a torque calibration procedure under rotation for nacelle test benches
authors: P Weidinger | G Foyer | S Kock | J Gnauert | R Kumme
locator: Crossref and 2019 JSSS references, Weidinger et al. 2018a.
finding: Earlier procedure cited by the rotating bench publication; recorded as a methodological predecessor. No independent run credited here.

title: Investigations towards extrapolation approaches for torque transducer characteristics
authors: P Weidinger | G Foyer | J Ala-Hiiro | C Schlegel | R Kumme
locator: Crossref and 2019 JSSS references, Weidinger et al. 2018c.
finding: Extrapolation of torque transducer characteristics provides a boundary when high test loads exceed the calibrated range.

title: State-of-the-art efficiency determination of a wind turbine drivetrain on a nacelle test bench
authors: Zhang Hongkun | Weidinger Paula | Mester Christian | Song Zihang | Heller Marcel | Dubowik Alexander | Tegtmeier Bernd | Eustorgi Karin
locator: Instrumentation, code and data availability, references Weidinger et al. 2023a/b.
finding: Commercial test campaign uses a drivetrain on the DyNaLab bench. Its experimental data and processing code could not be disclosed; the freely accessible linked calibration reports do not supply those runs.

title: Report describing the calibration of the 5 MN m torque transfer standard partially up to 1.1 MN m with an uncertainty < 0.1 % and in the full range up to 5 MN m with an uncertainty < 0.5 % with synchronised measurements of rotational speed up to 20 rpm on the low-speed shaft respectively torque measurements up to 100 kN m with synchronised measurements of rotational speed up to 1600 rpm on the high-speed shaft
authors: Weidinger, Paula | Song, Zihang | Oliveira, Rafael Soares de | Vavrečka, Lukáš | Fidelus, Janusz | Kananen, Timo | Heller, Marcel | Zhang, Hongkun
locator: Deliverable D3, calibration range and uncertainty, low/high speed shafts.
finding: Documents calibration of the transfer standard and speed acquisition; the ranges on the cover distinguish partial and full torque range.
rights: CC BY 4.0; PDF checked by repository MD5.

title: Good Practice Guide on the calibration procedure for traceable mechanical power measurement based on synchronised torque and rotational speed measurement
authors: Weidinger, Paula | Song, Zihang | Oliveira, Rafael Soares | Sander, Jonas | Vavrečka, Lukáš | Fidelus, Janusz | Heller, Marcel | Zhang, Hongkun | Zweiffel, Maximilian | Kananen, Timo
locator: Deliverable D4, good practice guide; torque/speed calibration procedures.
finding: Methodological guidance on torque and speed measurement for power determination. Quantitative procedures and illustrative results belong to a report, not a new time-series deposit.
rights: CC BY 4.0; PDF checked by repository MD5.
